summary.answer: UIImage.new forwards all eight layout arguments to UIElement.new, sets UIImage class, calls setupUIImage and returns self. GetCachedMaterial indexes Materials by requested key; only a nil cache entry calls RegisterMaterial and writes its return to the cache, then returns the cached value. False is a cache hit; a nil RegisterMaterial result can be retried next call. No image/native/material ownership or original runtime contract is supplied.
